_about: Control reference for ThreatForge mitigation mapping. Identifiers and titles are the genuine ones published by each framework; the `requirement` text is PARAPHRASED (a short summary in my own words), never the verbatim standard text. Consult the official sources for authoritative wording. Author: Krishita Sanjay Choksi.

sources.ASVS: OWASP Application Security Verification Standard v4.0.3
sources.NIST: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (Security and Privacy Controls)

controls.title: Password security
controls.requirement: User passwords must meet minimum length and strength expectations and be checked against breached-password lists.

controls.title: Multi-factor authentication
controls.requirement: Sensitive or administrative functions should require an additional authentication factor.

controls.title: General access control design
controls.requirement: Access control decisions must be enforced server-side and fail closed (deny by default).

controls.title: Least-privilege access control
controls.requirement: Users and services should only be granted the minimum privileges required for their function.

controls.title: Input validation
controls.requirement: All untrusted input should be validated against an allow-list of expected structure and type.

controls.title: Injection prevention
controls.requirement: Use parameterized queries or equivalent so untrusted data cannot alter query/command structure.

controls.title: Security event logging
controls.requirement: Security-relevant events should be logged with enough context to reconstruct what happened and who did it.

controls.title: Safe error handling
controls.requirement: Error responses shown to users must not leak stack traces or internal detail.

controls.title: Sensitive data in requests
controls.requirement: Sensitive data should not be placed in URLs or query strings where it can be logged or cached.

controls.title: Protect data at rest
controls.requirement: Sensitive data stored by the application should be classified and protected with encryption at rest.

controls.title: Transport security
controls.requirement: All communication should use strong, current TLS and reject plaintext transport.

controls.title: Anti-automation / rate limiting
controls.requirement: Protect resources from automated abuse with rate limiting and anti-automation controls.

controls.title: Data integrity in transit/storage
controls.requirement: Protect the integrity of data as it moves between components and while stored.

controls.title: Disable debug in production
controls.requirement: Debugging features and verbose diagnostics must be disabled in production builds.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.requirement: Uniquely identify and authenticate users before granting access to the system.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.requirement: Manage authenticators (passwords, tokens, keys) securely across their lifecycle.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.requirement: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and resources.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.requirement: Grant only the access required for users and processes to perform their tasks.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.requirement: Determine and log the security-relevant events the system must capture.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.requirement: Protect audit records and logging tools from unauthorized access and modification.

controls.title: Denial-of-Service Protection
controls.requirement: Protect against or limit the effects of denial-of-service conditions.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.requirement: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.requirement: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information while it is stored.

controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.requirement: Detect unauthorized changes to software, firmware and information.

controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Processing Purposes
controls.requirement: Process PII only for the authorized, documented purposes.

controls.title: Information Management and Retention
controls.requirement: Retain information only as long as needed and dispose of it securely.

controls.title: Data Minimisation (Art. 5(1)(c))
controls.requirement: Collect and keep only the personal data adequate and necessary for the purpose.

controls.title: Storage Limitation (Art. 5(1)(e))
controls.requirement: Keep personal data in identifiable form no longer than necessary.

controls.title: Information to the Data Subject (Art. 13)
controls.requirement: Inform data subjects about the processing of their personal data and obtain a lawful basis/consent.

controls.title: Data Protection by Design (Art. 25)
controls.requirement: Apply pseudonymisation and data-protection measures by design and by default.
